afk.about:
Mark yerself away from keyboard. Anyone who mentions or replies to ye while ye be AFK gets a notice wit' yer reason an' the time ye went AFK, so nobody waits fer an answer that be not coming.

Yer next missive ends yer AFK an' I tell ye how long ye were away. The same soul be told 'bout ye at most once a minute per chat, so the chat doesn't fill wit' notices. AFK follows ye into every chat I share wit' ye.

To add a photo, GIF or video, send it wit' /afk <reason> as the caption, or reply to it wit' /afk. It be shown wit' yer AFK notice.

antiflood.about:
Takes action on folk who flood the chat wit' missives. It be off until an admin turns it on wit' /setflood, fer example /setflood 10 to act on anyone who sends more than ten missives in a row (a mute by default). Bots, chat admins, approved users an' the bot's staff be ignored, an' an album o' photos counts as one missive.

Two rules can run side by side: the limit counts missives in a row from one soul, the timer counts missives from one soul within a time window, whoever else writes in 'tween.

The /set... commands be fer chat admins wit' the right to change chat info.

antiraid.about:
A raid be a crowd o' new accounts joining a chat within moments, usually to flood it. Wit' antiraid on, I count the joins: when too many come in a short time, the chat be in a raid fer a while, an' all hands who joins during it be dealt wit', as be the folk who made it a raid.

By default 10 joins within 1 minute make a raid, an' a raid lasts 1 hour. Newcomers be muted until the raid be o'er (they can write once it ends), or kicked, or banned. Chat admins, approved users, bots an' the bot's staff be ne'er touched.

Antiraid be off until a chat admin turns it on, an' I need the right to restrict users.

backups.about:
Save what this chat has set up, notes, filters, blacklists, rules, welcome aboard missives, locks, warns, approved users an' settings, in a file. Put it back in another chat, or in this one after a mistake.

Everything goes by default, or name the items ye want: /export notes approves. A file can hold several items; /import takes what it finds an' ye can pick from it the same way.

/import adds what be missing an' leaves what the chat already has alone. Add overwrite to replace the chat's own entries o' them items wit' the file's.

The file be sent to ye in private, so start a chat wit' me first. Only the cap'n o' the chat can use these commands. Anything in a file that doesn't look right be skipped, an' I tell ye how many.

Remove folk from the chat, fer good, fer a while, or just to show 'em the door.

These commands be fer chat admins wit' the right to ban users. Me staff (Sudo an' up) can use 'em too, unless the chat cap'n turned that off wit' /staffhelp.

Name the target by replying to their missive, or wit' a @username or a numeric ID. Anything after it be the reason, which be shown in the answer.

I won't act against chat admins, me own staff or protected accounts, an' I need the right to restrict users meself.

Times look like 30m, 2h, 3d or 1w, from 1 minute to 365 days.

Under every ban there be an Unban button, so ye don't have to look up the ID. It works fer admins an' staff who may ban, like /unban. Silent bans say naught, so they have no button.

captcha.about:
Some chats get a lot o' users joining just to spam. They may be trolls, or part o' a spam network.

To slow 'em down, turn captchas on. All hands who joins be muted an' has to pass a test to prove they're a real soul afore they can speak.

Captchas ride on the welcome aboard missive, so they only work while welcome aboard missives be on (/welcome). Wit' welcomes off nobody be muted.

Test types (/captchamode): button (press a button), math (pick the answer to a small sum), text (the code be written in the missive; press the scrambled characters in the order o' the code) an' text2 (the same, but the code be a picture).

How it looks: the newcomer's welcome aboard carries a verify button, the same fer all hands. In button mode one press unmutes 'em; the other modes (an' button mode wit' /captcharules) open a private chat wit' me where they solve the test. Some soul who be already verified only gets a small pop-up saying so.

If the chat uses join requests, the captcha be sent privately an' the request be approved once it be solved.

Time: /captchamutetime unmutes folk who haven't solved it after a while (by default they stay muted until they do). /captchakick removes folk who run out o' time (/captchakicktime). When both be set, the kick comes first.

Examples:
• Turn captchas on: /captcha on
• Use the math test: /captchamode math
• Make folk accept the rules too: /captcharules on
• Unmute after a day even if unsolved: /captchamutetime 1d
• Stay muted until solved: /captchamutetime off

I need the right to restrict users (an', fer join requests, to invite users).

disabling.about:
Chats can switch off what they don't need, in three ways.

/disable switches off single commands fer crewmates. /restrictmodule does the same fer every command o' a module. Admins can still use what be switched off fer crewmates, so nobody be locked out o' their own tools. Aliases go wit' the command.

/disablemodule turns a whole module off in the chat completely: its commands belay fer all hands, admins included, an' so does everything it does by itself (filters, locks, flood control, welcome aboard missives ...). Everything can go except this page: even /help an' /connect. Turning connections off ends the ones that exist. /disablemodule all turns off everything but this page; a chat that only wants global bans sends it an' then /enablemodule gbans. /enablemodule brings modules back. These two be fer the chat's cap'n.

Only the commands on this page can ne'er be switched off, so a chat can always undo what it did.

federations.about:
A federation links chats so that one ban works in all o' 'em. Create one, let yer chats join it, an' all hands it bans be removed from every chat o' the federation as soon as they show up there (write, edit, react, join or leave). A federation can also subscribe to others an' inherit their bans.

A chat be in one federation at a time. Chat admins an' approved users be ne'er removed by federation bans, an' federation admins can't be banned in their own federation. Me staff be not exempt: the owner o' a federation decides who be banned in it. Federations be identified by an ID like 3f1c2a3e-...: share it wit' the cap'ns o' the chats that should join.

Save the missive by writing it after the keyword, or by replying to a missive wit' the command: a replied-to photo, GIF, video, sticker, document, audio or voice missive be sent back as it be, wit' its text as the caption. The commands that change filters be fer chat admins wit' the right to change chat info.

greetings.about:
Greet folk when they join the chat an' say fair winds when they leave. Welcomes an' goodbyes be both on by default. Until ye set yer own, I use a default missive fer each.

A missive can be written after the command or taken from a missive ye reply to, media included. It can be formatted, address folk by name, carry buttons an' vary at random, as described below. Everything that changes these settings be fer chat admins wit' the right to change chat info.

Welcomes be sent when I see some soul join, an' goodbyes only when some soul leaves on their own: folk who be removed get none. Bots be not greeted.

Me staff (Support, Sudo, Developer, Cap'n) be different: they be always welcomed when they join an' seen off when they leave, wit' a missive o' their role, whatever the chat's settings be. They be not welcome aboard-muted or tested wit' a captcha.

joinblacklists.about:
Block folk from joining when their profile contains certain words, which stops spammers afore they post a single missive. There be four lists, one fer each part o' a profile that be checked: the name, the @username, the bio an' the personal channel (its name an' its username). Each chat can have up to 10 triggers per list.

Some soul who matches be banned an' the "joined" missive be removed. Bots, chat admins, approved users an' the bot's staff be ne'er blocked, an' neither be anyone who was added by a chat admin.

Triggers match whole words an' ignore case, so "casino" catches "Best Casino!" but not "casinos". To catch a word inside a longer one, use a wildcard: *casino* matches @best_casino_bot. Write one trigger per line to add several at once.

The commands that change the lists be fer chat admins wit' the right to change chat info. Anyone can look at 'em.

locks.about:
Lock a kind o' missive an' I delete every one o' 'em: stickers, links, forwards, voice missives, a whole alphabet... Locks do not affect chat admins, approved users or the bot's staff, an' edited missives be checked too. /locktypes explains every kind.

Locks that catch links, forwards, commands, stickers an' the like can be eased wit' the allowlist: whatever be on it stays allowed, so ye can lock all links but let one site through.

By default I just delete. Wit' /lockwarns on, whoever breaks a lock also gets a warn, an' be punished at the warn limit (see /warnmode). Wit' /lockmode ye can pick a punishment instead: mute, ban, kick, or a timed mute or ban.

Everything here be fer chat admins wit' the right to change chat info.

logchannel.about:
Every ban, mute, warn, promotion an' lock in this chat be written, wit' who did it an' why, into a log chat ye choose (an' so be everyone who joins or leaves on their own): a private crew o' the admins, or a channel. It keeps a history that outlives the missives in the chat.

To set it up, add me to the log chat as an admin (in a channel I need the right to post), then send here:
/setlog <chat id>
The id o' a chat be shown by /id when ye send it there. Fer a channel ye can also forward any post o' it here an' reply to that wit' /setlog.

Ye have to be an admin o' the log chat yerself. Silent commands like /sban leave no trace in the chat, but they be logged. A chat has one log.

Take away someone's right to write without removing 'em from the chat.

These commands be fer chat admins wit' the right to ban users. Me staff (Sudo an' up) can use 'em too, unless the chat cap'n turned that off wit' /staffhelp.

Name the target by replying to their missive, or wit' a @username or a numeric ID. Anything after it be the reason, which be shown in the answer.

nightmode.about:
Nightmode closes the chat at the hour ye choose an' opens it again in the mornin'. While it be closed, nobody but the admins can write; the chat's permissions from afore be saved an' put back exactly as they were.

By default the night lasts from 23:00 to 07:00 in UTC. Set yer own hours wit' /nighthours (a night may pass midnight) an' yer time zone wit' /nighttz, fer example /nighttz Europe/Warsaw or /nighttz UTC+1.

I announce both the closing an' the opening. Nightmode be off until a chat admin turns it on, an' I need the right to restrict crewmates.

warns.about:
Warns be strikes. Each one be saved wit' its reason, an' a user who reaches the chat's warn limit (3 by default) gets what /warnmode says (a ban unless the chat chose otherwise); the count then starts again from zero.

These commands be fer chat admins wit' the right to ban users. Me staff (Sudo an' up) can use 'em too, unless the chat cap'n turned that off wit' /staffhelp.

Name the target by replying to their missive, or wit' a @username or a numeric ID. Anything after it be the reason, which be shown in the answer.

I won't act against chat admins, me own staff or protected accounts, an' I need the right to restrict users meself.

Every warn has an ID. A fresh warning comes wit' a button to undo it, an' /warns lists a user's warns wit' buttons to remove each one.

Warn filters give a warn to whoever writes a word or phrase: /addwarn spam "free doubloons" an' the reason. They be blacklist triggers wit' the warn action, so they follow the blacklist rules (wildcards, whether the missive be deleted).

zombies.about:
Deleted accounts ("zombies") stay in a chat's crewmate list an' just take up room. /zombies removes 'em.

Where I can get the full crewmate list I check all hands. Otherwise I check the folk I have seen in this chat, them who wrote, joined or left while I was here. Then a deleted account that ne'er wrote anything here, or sat in the chat afore I came, stays out o' reach. Run it again after a while to catch more.

They be kicked, not banned. A deleted account can't come back anyway.

Fer chat admins wit' the right to ban users, an' I need that right too. Only one run per chat at a time.
